hardware.tested_state: get_signing_status reports development_accepted_gates separately from production missing_gates

procedure: Updated the shared get_signing_status contract to include development_accepted_gates alongside missing_gates.

Updated ESP32 host-core signing-status diagnostics to expose development evidence for parser limits, trusted-review display, physical approval controls, and approval-digest binding while preserving signing_disabled behavior.
Ran NostrSeal/specs make ci, NostrSeal/companion make ci, and NostrSeal/esp32 make ci before flashing.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke.
Verified idf.py and esptool.py paths and confirmed idf.py --version reported ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Built app version f5753e2 with make idf-build.
Flashed bootloader, app, and partition table to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 with make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-flash and verified image hashes.
expected_result: The firmware exposes development-accepted signing-readiness diagnostics separately from production blockers while preserving signing_disabled protocol behavior.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built app version f5753e2 with binary size 0x8e190 and 0x71e70 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The smoke passed with 35 verified exchanges: 8 valid response frames and 27 expected rejection frames. get_signing_status returned signing_enabled false, missing_gates containing runtime_signing_feature, trusted_review_display, physical_approval_controls, key_provisioning, secure_boot, flash_encryption, debug_lock, and companion_signed_output_verification, and development_accepted_gates containing parser_limits, trusted_review_display, physical_approval_controls, and approval_digest_binding. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no production key custody, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, companion signed-output verification, or real signing acceptance was tested.
development_accepted_gates records manual/development evidence only and does not remove any production blocker from missing_gates.
get_signing_status is diagnostic only and does not authorize signing.
get_public_key still uses the deterministic development fixture key.
sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until trusted display review, physical approval, provisioning, storage, signed-output verification, and firmware hardening gates are complete.
